description: This file defines a SQLAlchemy ORM model class 'Trade' representing a trade entity with various attributes such as id, user_id, symbol, action, quantity, price, status, executed_at, extra, and created_at. It is part of a trading backend service, specifically modeling trades in the application's database schema.

classes.name: Trade
classes.description: Represents a trade (buy/sell order) placed by the user with attributes for tracking trade details and status.
